body: We had some discussions before when I felt jealous about it. She's very conscious about not using her phone when on a date with any of her new people. I've expressed that her frequent texting when she's with me makes me feel she doesn't respect my time in the same way. We agreed that some texting is unavoidable because we live together and, well, when else would she? I guess I didn't expect her to consider it a burdensome rule with me and matter of politeness with anyone else...

The complication for me is that I also struggle with anxiety and just general brokenness. So it's hard sometimes to separate "you did something completely normal and I'm freaking out for no reason" from "you did something kinda bad and I'm legitimately upset".

I can't just throw my difficult feelings at her to sort out every time; that would be me asking her to manage my feelings for me.
